title: Selective carbon–carbon bond cleavage involving alkene moieties
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01173F, Tutorial Review
Qixue Qin, Xiao-De An, Shuanghong Hao, Ning Jiao
This review has systematically surveyed the recent groundbreaking advances of the cleavage of robust σ-bonds adjacent to the alkene and the novel transformations such as nitrogenation and oxygenation reactions through CC double bond cleavage.
